No suspicious code execution, no fetching from unrelated hosts, no obfuscation. The 'inconclusive' result from qwen3-235b was due to an API error (HTTP 400), not a security finding. learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should not result in 'inconclusive' verdicts when partial evidence is available - the initial PKGBUILD parse-time audit succeeded in the qwen3-235b report and could have been weighted

For -bin packages, models should explicitly verify that: (1) sources come from the project's own upstream, (2) checksums are provided and not SKIP, (3) no code execution occurs during build beyond extraction/installation

The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to missing evidence' and 'inconclusive due to tool error' - the latter should trigger a retry or fallback, not a permanent inconclusive verdict
